items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: because I know Albert and I know his brother, Joe.

ctx.x: Well, they had a rumor out that he died when Joe died, you know, his nephew Joe. Oh yeah. When he died, they had a rumor out that Albert died and then Albert said it wasn't true.

Well, I don't know if that's his nephew or not. Now, they might be cousins or something like that because I know Albert and I know his brother, Joe. He's got a brother by the name of Joe Schneier too. Joe is in California. But this Joe Schneier that died, now they might be some kind of cousin or something, but I know, I don't think it's his nephew.
I used to hear him with Giles up I think in the 1300 block of St. Charles.
